value.title: The Destroyed Army's Howling Engraving
value.synopsis: A stranger breaks into the temple, defeating everyone who faces him by himself. He's after the sword - "Kenkaranpu". But why is he so desperate to get it? And will Taitou and his sister be able to stop him?

value.title: Military Song of Karma
value.synopsis: The fight continues with the mysterious enemy, and the big adventure truly begins.

value.title: Honorable Pledge
value.synopsis: The group visit a small town with a huge boulder looming dangerously over the cliff above it. But that's not the only danger, the goverment officals are corrupt and don't care about the people. Will the group be able to stop both? And who is "Koyo"?

value.title: The Five Divine Warriors
value.synopsis: The group meets a strange boy, all the arrows and bows he use explode because of the energy put into them. Who exactly is he and which side is he on?

value.title: The Diseased Empire
value.synopsis: The group meet some orphans, who have to steal to live. Unfortunately, they've angered some thugs who are known to kill anyone who try and face them. Will the group be able to protect the orphans?

value.title: Crimson Hero
value.synopsis: The journey continues, and this time the group meets up with Housei's master. Will Taito accept her offer to train with her?

value.title: The Shadows Cast Upon the Capital
Turning Away from the Fierce Fang
